name: neowiki_violation
comment: One row per Violation of a Subject a page publishes, as validating it against its Schema finds them with every page readable. Written by jobs after the page or a Schema or relation target it depends on changes, so it can lag. Derived data: rebuildable from the pages at any time.

columns.name: nwv_page_id
columns.comment: Page whose subject slot holds the Subject

columns.name: nwv_subject_id
columns.comment: Subject id, bare: a slot holds Subjects of this wiki only

columns.name: nwv_schema
columns.comment: Name of the Subject's Schema, without its Source, cut to 255 bytes on a character boundary

columns.name: nwv_property
columns.comment: Name of the property the Violation is about, cut to 255 bytes on a character boundary. Null for one about the Subject as a whole, such as a Schema that is not found.

columns.name: nwv_code
columns.comment: The Violation's code, such as required or relation-target-not-found

columns.name: nwv_value_part
columns.comment: Index of the value part the Violation is about, null when it is about the whole value

columns.name: nwv_target_id
columns.comment: Id of the relation target the Violation is about, null for one about no relation target. Lets a list show it only to readers of the target.

columns.name: nwv_args
columns.comment: The Violation's message arguments, as a JSON list

indexes.name: nwv_page_id
indexes.comment: For replacing the Violations of one page

indexes.name: nwv_severity_id
indexes.comment: For listing the Violations of one severity

indexes.name: nwv_schema_id
indexes.comment: For listing the Violations of the Subjects of one Schema

indexes.name: nwv_target_id
indexes.comment: For finding the pages recorded with Violations about a relation target, to check again once it exists

indexes.name: nwv_code_id
indexes.comment: For listing the Violations of one code
